statement: Across additional genomes not used to create Proof Case 0001, the shorter nested LC-PRIM-0003 core should have a broader phylogenetic distribution than its 24-bp parent LC-PRIM-0002, while retaining enrichment in large-subunit-rRNA-associated contexts.
test: Search additional predeclared bacterial, archaeal, and organellar genomes for exact direct/reverse-complement occurrences of LC-PRIM-0002 and LC-PRIM-0003, then annotate only after occurrence counts are frozen.
support_condition: LC-PRIM-0003 occurs in a strict superset or materially broader taxonomic set than LC-PRIM-0002 and post-freeze annotations remain enriched for large-subunit-rRNA contexts.
weakening_condition: Distribution breadth is similar or the core expands broadly but loses rRNA-context enrichment.
falsification_condition: The parent LC-PRIM-0002 is as broad or broader than LC-PRIM-0003 across independent genomes, or LC-PRIM-0003 is predominantly unrelated to large-subunit-rRNA contexts.
contamination_boundary: Prospective codebook prediction; no additional-genome results were inspected before freeze.
